preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain control of owner address)
Attacker needs some token balance to demonstrate fee extraction

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call updateFee() to set txFee to a high value (e.g., 99), then set FeeAddress to your own address. Transfer tokens from a victim account to trigger fee collection. The fee calculation uses 'tempValue.div(uint256(100 / txFee))' which can be manipulated to extract nearly all transferred tokens as fees when txFee is high.
